component.name: GitNest
component.summary: Git GUI Client for AI-assisted coding

description.p: GitNest is a cross-platform Git GUI client tailored for AI-assisted coding workflows, built on SourceGit. It helps developers review cumulative AI changes, inspect diffs, commit and sync safely, and clean up task worktrees and branches.

ul.li: Simplified Chinese and English UI with light and dark themes
Worktree task overview and cumulative task diff review
Safe commit, fast-forward pull, single-branch push, and directed merge
Protected branches, explicit force-with-lease, and 30-day local recovery backups
Scoped Git configuration viewer and editor
